title: Submit a property — Green Light Buying Machine
description: Wholesalers, agents and owners: send us a property you think converts to co-living.
heading: Submit a property
lede: Have a house you think would make a good co-living conversion? Send it over. We'll underwrite it the Green Light way and tell you what we see.

blocks.aside:
What we look for

  • Distressed or dated — we'd rather do the work
  • A footprint that can carry at least eight bedrooms
  • Somewhere residents actually want to live
  • Numbers that leave room for a conversion budget

Not every property works, and we'll tell you why when one doesn't. Send the next one anyway.

Want to build them instead?

If you're an operator with 10 to 15 flips behind you, apply to become a student.
